children: Dr Lal Pathlabs (DLPL) has announced the acquisition of SN Genelab — a B2B diagnostics operator focused on advanced genomics and molecular pathology testing — for ₹168 crore (70 per cent stake), thus valuing the company at around 16x FY26 EV/EBITDA.

We expect the company to cross-sell SN Genelab’s test offerings on its wider platform (both B2B and B2C channels) and expect revenue synergies to accrue in the next 2-3 years. Per management, this acquisition allows for deepening DLPL’s specialized testing portfolio as well as enabling geographical diversification of the revenue base (West region contributed 14 per cent to FY26 revenue).  We find the valuation for this acquisition reasonable, given the strong financials and profitable growth demonstrated by SN Genelab.

DLPL’s leadership position and execution prowess position it to benefit from the current industry tailwinds (stable pricing environment, shift toward quality organised operators, and increasing adoption of preventive testing). We expect revenue/EBITDA CAGR of 15/16 per cent over FY26-29 (ex-acquisition) and retain Buy.
We raise our Sep-27E TP by 5 per cent to ₹2,100 from ₹2,000 (based on DCF method), implying FY28E PER of 48x (in line with LTA).
Key risks: Irrational pricing environment, inflationary pressures owing to ME crisis, and disruption in the raw-material supply chain.

title: Broker’s call: Dr Lal Pathlabs
